# Technical summary

ExcludedValidation was added to the finalized six-donor Xenium SFE after applying its
recorded QC flag, yielding **21,271 Xenium cells from seven donors**. Of the
retained ExcludedValidation cells, **`r ssc230_matched`** have validated IMC-Xenium shared
identifiers;
**`r panel_audit_value[["ExcludedValidation paired FibMET"]]`** contribute to paired
FibMET analyses and **`r panel_audit_value[["ExcludedValidation paired EndMET"]]`**
contribute to paired EndMET analyses.

An unsupervised ResolVI model was fitted jointly to raw Xenium counts and
spatial coordinates from all seven donors. `SampleId` was used as the batch
key, and the two acquisition slides reconstructed from the original ResolVI
input H5AD were included as a categorical covariate. The model generated a
30-dimensional latent representation, normalized expression
(`scvi_norm_expr`), and posterior-median corrected expression
(`px_rate_q50`).

The final manuscript labels deliberately separate unsupervised model fitting
from biological annotation. The curated labels of the original six donors are
preserved exactly. ExcludedValidation alone is mapped in the all-seven ResolVI latent by a
k-nearest-neighbor classifier whose settings were selected by
leave-one-donor-out label-transfer validation across the six reference donors.
All seven donors contribute to model training and latent geometry, but ExcludedValidation
labels are excluded from classifier training.

The fixed-latent leave-one-donor-out accuracy was
**`r format_percent(major_lodo_accuracy)`** for major populations,
with **`r format_percent(major_lodo_balanced_accuracy)`** balanced accuracy,
**`r format_percent(fib_lodo_accuracy)`** for fibroblast subtypes, and
**`r format_percent(ec_lodo_accuracy)`** for endothelial subtypes. ExcludedValidation
agreement with the prior Seurat RNA-anchor mapping was
**`r format_percent(ssc230_major_agreement)`** for broad labels and
**`r format_percent(ssc230_subtype_agreement)`** for comparable Fib/EC
subtypes. These values quantify transfer stability; they are not evidence that
the two mappings are interchangeable.

Unsupervised Leiden cluster-majority labels are retained as a sensitivity
output only. Their six-donor major-label accuracy was
**`r format_percent(cluster_majority_accuracy)`**, and the partition merged
rare lineages and several fine subtypes. It is therefore not used to overwrite
the curated six-donor labels.

All applicable IMC-only, paired IMC-Xenium, scMetabolism, ECM, Sankey, and
Xenium-only annotation panels were regenerated with all seven donors. Every
panel is exported as PNG, PDF, and SVG using the original manuscript palette,
fixed score ranges, and panel dimensions.

## Figure S6A: major populations

The all-seven ResolVI embedding is colored with the final manuscript labels:
curated labels for the original six donors and joint-ResolVI latent mapping for

the previously curated cells.

# Joint ResolVI annotation validation {.tabset .tabset-pill}

## Concordance

These metrics quantify three distinct questions: how well labels transfer
between held-out reference donors in the fixed joint latent, how the new
ExcludedValidation latent mapping agrees with the previous RNA-anchor mapping, and how much
information would be lost by using unsupervised cluster-majority labels as the
final annotation. The strategy decision is recorded alongside the numerical
audit.

```{r annotation_concordance}
kable(strategy_metrics, digits = 3)
kable(strategy_decision)
```

# Scope and methods

The ExcludedValidation portable SFE was restricted to `qc_pass == TRUE` before joining.
The final object contains the identical 5,099-gene row universe for all seven
donors. Counts, logcounts, centroid geometries, and cell-segmentation geometries
were retained.

The joint model was trained with scvi-tools `r training_manifest$versions$scvi_tools`
for `r training_manifest$config$max_epochs` epochs. ResolVI constructed spatial
neighbors separately within each donor from `X_spatial`. UMAP, Leiden
sensitivity clusters, and label-transfer classifiers use all 30 latent
dimensions.

For final annotation, major-population, fibroblast-subtype, and
endothelial-subtype k-nearest-neighbor classifiers were tuned by withholding
one of the six reference donors at a time. This is label-transfer validation
within a fixed all-seven latent, not a full model-refit cross-validation:
the held-out donor still contributed unlabeled counts and spatial context when
ResolVI was trained. After selecting `k` and distance weighting, the mapper was
trained on all six curated donors and applied only to ExcludedValidation. Unsupervised
Leiden partitions were evaluated separately and retained as sensitivity
columns.

scMetabolism was run with AUCell and the KEGG pathway collection on all final
Xenium fibroblasts and ECs. ECM scores were calculated with AUCell from the
Naba core-matrisome network. IMC glycolysis and TCA/OXPHOS scores are means of
the prespecified z-scored protein marker sets.

```{r cohort_tables}
kable(join_audit, caption = "Joined seven-donor Xenium SFE")
kable(panel_audit, caption = "Cell denominators used in regenerated panels")
```

# ResolVI model provenance

The candidate checkpoint recovered from Yi-Nan Li's `sscskin_metabolic`
project is a supervised scANVI model trained on the Haniffa skin fibroblast
atlas. It is not the model that generated the manuscript Xenium embedding.
The available six-donor workflow documentation instead records `X_resolvi`
and `scvi_norm_expr` from an unsupervised ResolVI H5AD. Accordingly, the
seven-donor model reported here is an unsupervised ResolVI refit rather than
an extension of the unrelated fibroblast-atlas scANVI classifier.

Other recovered ResolVI artifacts belonged to unrelated datasets and were
excluded. The production input is exclusively the checksummed 21,271-cell
seven-donor SFE distributed with this report.

```{r model_provenance}
kable(training_table, caption = "Joint seven-donor ResolVI training contract")
```

The saved model directory, console training log, parsed ELBO trajectory, H5AD,
input and output checksums, annotation resolution grids, cluster-label maps,
and package lock file are distributed with this report. The annotation
manifest records the exact model H5AD checksum used to make the labels.

# Limitations and robustness

<div class="method-note">
The original six-donor training command and trained H5AD were not recoverable.
This is a new unsupervised ResolVI fit of the correct seven-donor SFE, using the
documented 30-dimensional latent, raw counts, spatial coordinates, donor batch,
and acquisition-slide covariate. It is therefore a method-equivalent refit, not
a byte-for-byte continuation of unverifiable original hyperparameters.
</div>

The joint latent does not recover every curated subtype as a clean unsupervised
cluster. In particular, cluster-majority annotation merges rare major
lineages and has inadequate fine-subtype retention. For that reason, the
cluster calls are a sensitivity analysis and no original six-donor cell is
relabelled in the final SFE. ExcludedValidation subtype conclusions should be interpreted
alongside the leave-one-donor-out performance, mapping confidence, agreement
tables, and marker-QC panels.

The targeted Xenium panel does not pass scMetabolism's coverage threshold for a
separate KEGG oxidative-phosphorylation gene set. The transcriptomic
`TCA / OXPHOS` display row is therefore the citrate-cycle score used in the
previous analysis; no missing OXPHOS value was imputed. The IMC protein score
does include the prespecified TCA/OXPHOS protein markers.

Cell-level distribution tests and correlations can be affected by donor
composition and within-donor dependence. Donor-level plots are shown where
the scientific comparison is inferential; the matched-cell correlations are
descriptive cross-modal checks.

# Recommended manuscript use

Use these panels when the manuscript question requires all seven donors to
contribute to one spatial generative model while preserving the established
six-donor annotation. State explicitly that ResolVI training was unsupervised,
that the six curated donors were unchanged, and that only ExcludedValidation was mapped in
the joint latent. Report the sample-aware transfer metrics and the agreement
with the prior RNA-anchor mapping rather than implying that unsupervised
clusters reproduced every curated subtype.

# Further questions

Manual review remains appropriate before treating any ExcludedValidation fine-subtype
assignment as definitive. Recovery of the original training command would
permit a stricter hyperparameter-matched sensitivity fit, but is not required
to rerun the model and report delivered here.
